title: Safeguard Lanes — Decision-Assist Rollout Composer and Failure-mode Simulation Sandbox
creator: Priya Nair
description: Goal: Design a composable rollout composer UI called 'Safeguard Lanes' that helps operators build canary/A-B traffic splits, run failure-mode simulations (latency, error spikes, cold-starts), and receive actionable decision-assist guidance (suggest rollback, quarantine, or continue) prior to and during an active rollout. The feature should surface expected user-visible impact, token/cost delta, and SLO risk in a compact timeline view. Background: customers have asked for a single place to rehearse traffic shifts, validate guardrails, and get an explainable rollback recommendation tied to observed signals and policy thresholds. This ticket covers the flow-level prototypes, a lightweight simulation sandbox, and high-level handoff artifacts for Eng and PM.
acceptance_criteria: Composer canvas supports creating up to 4 lanes (baseline + up to 3 variants) with percentage-based splits and time-based ramps
Simulation sandbox can inject at least three failure scenarios (latency spike, error-rate spike, and region outage) and show projected SLO breaches over the rollout timeline
Decision-assist panel presents a clear recommended action (Rollback / Pause / Quarantine / Continue) with 1–2 sentence rationale and the top 3 contributing signals
Audit trail items (who changed what and when) are visible in the composer for the last 30 days
Prototype validated in a 5-user usability test with SUS score >= 75 and no major confusion around lane manipulation
Engineering sign-off on feasible initial scope (no custom scripting, uses existing rollout API surface)
risks: Simulation accuracy: initial version will be approximate (rules-based) rather than run-time faithful; must label as 'estimate'
Complexity overload: too many knobs will harm discoverability; need a simplified 'quick-start' composer
Data latency: realtime SLO signals may lag and cause false positives for decision-assist
decisions: Ship first iteration as a sandboxed estimator (no live-traffic control) that can export a rollout plan to the server for execution
Expose a compact 'Quick Mode' with three canned presets (Conservative, Balanced, Aggressive) to reduce setup time
Decision-assist will be rules + heuristics for v1; ML-backed suggestions deferred to a later project
comments: 2026-02-12 Priya Nair: Created ticket with initial problem framing after PM strategy sync. Linked request from two enterprise customers asking for pre-flight rehearsal and auditable rollbacks.

2026-02-24 Diego Morales (Eng): Engineering review — can implement lane model and percent ramps but suggests limiting variant count to 3 for v1 to reduce scheduling complexity. Also flagged need for rollout API fields: 'sim_policy' and 'audit_tokens'.

2026-02-28 Lina Eriksson (PM): Feedback from customer interviews added — demand for export-to-execution button and CSV diff of traffic allocations. PM asks for a visual 'what-if' cost delta estimate per variant.

2026-03-08 Ava Kim: Updated prototype with decision-assist panel and three canned scenarios. Added explicit 'simulation confidence' badge (Estimate / Low / High). Preparing handoff doc for Eng.

2026-03-10 Diego Morales: Engineering sign-off on scope with caveats: simulation will run client-side with historical SLO trend inputs; export action will create a 'Draft Rollout' resource for server-side validation.
acceptance_test_plan: Run the prototype scenario: baseline at 80% -> variant A ramp to 20% over 10 minutes; inject error spike at minute 4; simulation should flag 'high risk' and recommend Pause/Quarantine
Verify audit trail captures composer changes and export action metadata for two sample users
Confirm that the quick-mode presets create the expected percent/time plan (Conservative = slow ramp, Aggressive = fast ramp)
Engineering to run simple e2e: composer export creates Draft Rollout and validation API returns expected schema
